reviews.text:
Simple Apps with elaborate function. I was looking for a simple Tarot app with a Tarot library, and this app really does the job. Its library only gives brief descriptions of card meanings, but it also provides details regarding each card, such as astrology association, yes/no, numerology, season association, and etc.I like this simplicity, as it leaves a lot of open-endness for the reader to freely adapt each readings. It is a great app to learn Tarot. 

In addition, the app offers one free AI-powered reading per day. The AI generated reading is surprisingly comprehensive, and I have been using it to learn how to phrase and interpret different card groupings/spread.

Problem. I did not receive my reading today. The message I received said AI was unable to do my reading at the moment and to restart. I tried again and then restart but was told I already received two readings today. But I didn’t. Never had a problem before today.
